rundown: Pistons beat Magic 104-86 at Kia Center in Orlando, FL in front of 19,352. Pistons led 48-36 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Pistons won it 32-14.
Leading the way — Pistons: Isaiah Joe 21 pts; Daniss Jenkins 10 ast; Ausar Thompson 10 reb. Magic: Desmond Bane 21 pts; Franz Wagner 6 ast; Wendell Carter Jr. 13 reb.
Where Pistons won it: they shot 49% to 41%, shot 42% from three to 33% and won the boards 42-41.

Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Magic closed as 3.5-point favorites and lost outright to Pistons; Pistons won as the underdog at +126; the total closed at 210.5 and they combined for 190, under by 20.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 6:55 PM ET. It had Pistons 45% and Magic 55%, projecting Pistons 110 – Magic 111.5 (221.4 total, Magic by 1.5).

Final: Pistons 104 – Magic 86. Wrong winner: it had Magic at 55%, and Pistons (45%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pistons came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (10-6, 113.4 scored and 108.6 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 98 and 99 games of evidence. Projected to score 110, they scored 104 (−6 points, 5% under); projected to allow 111.5, they allowed 86 (−25.5 points, 23% under).

Magic came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (7-9, 108.8 scored and 112.9 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 98 and 97 games of evidence. Projected to score 111.5, they scored 86 (−25.5 points, 23% under); projected to allow 110, they allowed 104 (−6 points, 5% under).

The bigger miss was Magic's scoring (-25.5 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 190 against 221.4 projected (-31.4), about the 4th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Pistons by 18 against Magic by 1.5 projected, about the 5th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Magic ×1.02, Pistons ×1.00. It favored Magic, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ORL ML (-149) at -149: the algo gave it 57% vs 57% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 58%). DET ML (+126) at +126: the algo gave it 43% vs 43% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+1.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 42%). ORL -3.5 (-106) at -106: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. DET +3.5 (-114) at -114: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 210.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+2.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 210.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-2.2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 51% of bets on Pistons, 45% of the money — Pistons covered; total: 76% of bets on the over, 73% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 75% of bets on Pistons, 74% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Magic, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.852 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -19.3 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 152 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.992 and gives home teams +0.1 points. Team corrections so far: Pistons attack ×0.997, defense ×1.009 (10 games); Magic attack ×0.988, defense ×0.997 (10 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 19.5 points), no bet.
